item.tib: smug mo srid pa rgyal mo'i thugs sgrubs 'dod 'byung
item.coloph: man ngag thems su bstan ma 'di/ srid pa rgyal mo'i thugs sgrab/ ma mo las kyi srog gzer/ yang gsang thugs kyi gzer bu'i/ them yig (busang) bcas pa/ mkhas pa mi bdun gyi bka' lung / gsang na bon skyongs yang rig mkhas pa stong rgyung mthu chen gyis/ drung mu ha ra bdag la gnang*/ rdzogs so//
